referenceFunction.generalComment: Calculation for transport distances assuming transport by pipeline offshore and onshore as well as sea transport in tanker. Sites and modes of transportation based on the supply situation in 2023. UUID=91c60006-27a9-30eb-b8be-ee8c98f727f0
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Transportation of crude oil from exploration sites to refineries in RU-region. Includes transport service requirements and emissions from oil handling and evaporation.
referenceFunction.localName: Crude oil, market mix, at long distance transport
referenceFunction.name: Crude oil, market mix, at long distance transport

geography.text: Calculations include production and transport of crude oil from 11 countries.

technology.text: Operation of crude oil pipelines by electricity.

representativeness.productionVolume: 308.1 million tons of directly imported crude oil to RU region in 2023.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Literature. Online calculators for distances. The consumption mix is calculated based on international trade statistics for 2023.

exchange.generalComment: (1,1,1,3,3,BU:1.05); In 2023, 1.033 megatons of crude oil are imported from Argentina to Russian Federation, assuming 30% offshore production. Assumed transport distances: Offshore, at origin: 100km by pipeline. Onshore, at origin: 500km by pipeline. For transport to destination: 14044km by ship plus additional 100km by onshore pipeline at destination. Port of origin for shipping is assumed to be Buenos Aires.
